mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where this trigger is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5% for two consecutive months indicates a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered episodes during periods of tight labor markets.

mechanism_narrative: A sequential decline in both personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and drags down the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 4% while the federal funds rate remains below 2% for three months, it signals a lagged monetary policy response, which typically precedes a future rate hike and causes equity volatility and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) of more than 200,000 in two consecutive months signals an acceleration in labor market tightness, which precedes margin compression and negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% signals broad-based demand weakness, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and INDPRO both fall > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction-related equity earnings and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month moving average for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered housing recoveries.
